claim: Professor Barton Beebe's empirical study found that of the core opinions in which factor one favored fair use, 92.2% ultimately found fair use, while of those in which factor one disfavored fair use, 96.6% found no fair use.
excerpt:
53 decisions found factor two favored fair use, of which 39 (73.6%) found fair use. 154 decisions found factor two disfavored fair use, of which 91 (59.1%) found no fair use.
